result:
I've failed round 327 (PERF-DRAG-PREVIEW stage b) on one Medium finding. Every acceptance row in the task passed. The failure comes from a difference against HEAD in the status announcement area, which the task named as at risk in §4. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are true: every browser row ran at 1440×900 and 1280×720, and the export ran.

**What passed (A's tree compared with HEAD `234ccdd`, same pointer paths):**
- **Claims, source scope, docs:** all match. Exactly the 11 granted files changed, protected files are 11/11, and the source was unchanged during my run.
- **Unit and mutant tests:** both covering files are 21/21 on three runs. The two required mutants, plus two of my own, each fail on the rows they should. The restored file is green.
- **Performance (production build, run alone):** fade drag renders dropped from 103.25 to 21.633 per move (max 105 → 22), with 0 audio restarts. All five new budget rows pass. Trim, move and range rows are unchanged. Stopped release now takes 2 commits instead of 1. I could not measure that the second commit renders 0 components; that figure is still only B's.
- **Fade drag status, cancel on blur, end of playback, playing drag, video fade:** the text at every step, the span changes, the final text, the Undo title and Undo itself all match HEAD at both viewports. No audio source restarts during a playing drag.
- **Export:** Fade In set to 2.000 s by dragging. The WAV is byte-identical between A and HEAD (16 s, 48 kHz/24-bit), and the fade is visible in the samples.
- **Premium auth is not bypassed:** `/studio-lab` opens anonymously as the demo with no `auth_user`. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" and loads no audio. `/api/studio-token` with no header returns 401.

**Findings, returned to B:**
- **C-R327-01 (Medium):** the round's code (B's design, applied verbatim by A) briefly puts the old status text back while a fade is being dragged.
  - **Steps:** the public-preview MP3s are still downloading. Add "Pulse" and hold a Fade In drag. The last MP3 arrives mid-drag.
  - **Result:** the status region swaps back to the old "…added to the Music track…" sentence for about 6 ms, then re-adds "Fade In: 1.250 s" as a new element. Screen readers may announce it again. HEAD shows no change at all.
  - **Reproduced:** 3 of 3 runs, both viewports. A's code reviewer flagged this; A's jsdom probe could not reproduce it.
  - **Visibility:** I never caught the old text in a drawn frame, so a visible flash is unlikely but not ruled out. Whether a screen reader actually speaks the old sentence is unverified; there is no screen reader in the cloud.
  - **How likely:** my probe held the MP3 downloads to make the timing exact. Together they are 7.7 MB, so at an ordinary 10 Mbit/s the timing window is a few seconds (my estimate). The video import is the other delayed status writer; it behaved like HEAD.
- **C-R327-02 (Low):** this is A's own open STOP item, now confirmed in a real browser. After the case above, moving the pointer without changing the fade value redraws the status text once. HEAD keeps the same element. B should rule on both findings together: the fix A proposed (option b) fixes only C-R327-02.

I also recorded one info item. In a project with no BPM, my Alt-click on the bars ruler did not move the insert marker, on both A and HEAD. It is not a change from this round, and I did not establish whether it is expected.

Everything is in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`: the report and JSON are `c-round-327.md` and `c-round-327.json`; scripts, logs, 52 screenshots and the probes are under `c-round-327/`.
